name: scalp-city
description: Scalp City — real-time trading command center with a 3D city interface, Alpaca brokerage connectivity, and server-side risk controls.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @scalp-city/web && npm run build -w @scalp-city/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @scalp-city/shared && npm run typecheck -w @scalp-city/server && npm run typecheck -w @scalp-city/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @scalp-city/shared && npm run test -w @scalp-city/server
